## (Im)Pure functions in Programming

Haskell is known as a _pure_ functional programming language. We talked about
pure/impure functions previously in <../interfaces_as_list_of_propositions/#interfaces-as-list-of-propositions>.
To recapitulate: a _pure_ function is one that does not modify or depend on
_outside state_.
